To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

our proposed MMDCRBMs approach is able to achieve state-of-the-art results in classification, localization, and data generation for the Chalearn dataset, as well as in classification for the audio-mocap dataset.
our proposed MMDCRBMs method is able to outperform state-of-the-art models in classification, generation and localization tasks.
our hybrid approach is able to outperform the state-of-the-arts on multimodal event detection, and multimodal data generation.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following: (a) developing a hybrid model to exploit the advantages of generative and discriminative approaches, and (b) developing a model that learns a joint representation space across multiple modalities.
the development of a new hybrid model that combines the advantages of generative and discriminative models.
the problem of multimodal data classification and data generation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we are able to learn the multimodal representations and the discriminative classifier simultaneously.
our proposed model is capable of generating missing data and detecting events in a multimodal time series data.
our proposed model outperforms the state-of-the art methods in terms of classification accuracy, generation and localization accuracy on all of the datasets used in this paper.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we propose a novel hybrid approach that jointly optimizes a shared representation space across multiple modalities and discriminative component to achieve higher performance in multimodal fusion tasks.
we propose a novel hybrid deep learning model that combines the strength of discriminators and generators.
our model achieves state-of-the-art performance for both the multimodal classification and generation tasks.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the discriminative component of the model helps in improving the performance of the generative component and vice-versa.
the discriminative model can be used to train the generative model and the generative model can be exploited to generate the lower level data.
the hybrid model outperforms the discriminative model as well as the generative model in all the datasets.
